correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<=H<I and R=I-H positive definite, Ddirect is a positive quadratic form on exactly mn independent normal coordinates; the ellipsoid small-ball volume gives the coefficient with det(R)^(-m/2) and exponent mn/2. S_H=sum of independent positive-eigenvalue gamma variables has strictly positive smooth density at n, so n-S_H has linear two-sided small-ball probability and the squared score has t^-1/2 tail. Layer-cake integration yields q thresholds including divergence on equality. Norm sqrt(n) probes satisfy z^T R z=n-z^T H z>=n lambda_min(R) samplewise. Independent rational checks verified the n=2,m=3 example E[Gdirect]=9/8 and 60 fixed-norm identities.

value.rationale: Generalized cross-validation is a standard regularization functional. The observation that unbiased algebraically identical trace placements have different sharp inverse-moment classes is a consequential estimator reliability boundary; it distinguishes integrability failure from variance inflation.

final_claim: With unnormalized Gaussian probes, direct Monte Carlo trace of R=I-H gives GCV positive moment q iff q<mn/4, while n minus trace of nonzero H gives q iff q<1/2 independent of m; sharp tail constants and samplewise bounded fixed-norm-isotropic remedy.
limitations: Fixed positive-contraction smoother and fixed nonzero residual numerator, independent unnormalized Gaussian or fixed-norm isotropic probes.
60 exact finite fixed-norm checks and scalar chi-square evaluation do not prove the all-moment statement.
